entries.note: Taken in at a Kyrgyz post office. The reply names the office after it, sometimes with its postcode, which the adapter drops.
The UPU's IPS event "Receive item at office of exchange (Otb)", relayed from the sending post. The reply adds "Офис:" and the office, which the adapter reads as the scan's place.
The UPU's IPS event "Insert item into bag (Otb)", relayed from the sending post. The reply adds "Офис:" and the office, which the adapter reads as the scan's place.
Arrived at Kyrgyz Post's international mail exchange.

entries.wording: Отправлено из ЦМПОЛ в Бишкек почтамт РФ
entries.note: Sent on from the international exchange to the Bishkek main post office.

entries.wording: Отправлено из РФ в отделение связи
entries.note: Sent on to the post office that delivers it. The reply names the office after it.
Arrived at the post office that delivers it, the last scan before the delivery. The reply names the office after it.
Handed to the recipient. The reply ends it with a space and names nobody.
An item posted in Kyrgyzstan sent abroad from the international exchange, the last scan the tracker shows for it.
